csv_scope_of_work: The Virgin Islands Housing Finance Authority (VIHFA), through its Community Development Block Grant Disaster Recovery (CDBG-DR) Program, is soliciting proposals from qualified and licensed Professional Architects and Engineers in the United States Virgin Islands (USVI) to provide Architectural and Engineering (A/E) Design Services for the Queen Louise Revitalization Project located at Parcel No. 15 Consolidated and Parcel No. 13 Consolidated Nordsidevej, Queens Quarter, St. Thomas, U.S. Virgin Islands.
